new_senses.rationale: One active-looking learned form Mšayanle with lebe as affected object; adjacent native paraphrases describe softening, reassurance and pleasure. No unobserved Infectum form is supplied.
štayan lebe in the preceding line presents the affected heart without an agent. Paired learned forms support a provisional II/Detransitive contrast, not a proven productive native paradigm.

added_examples.turoyo: Yaʕni rabe w greʕe w flan sə Aloho kulle, u ḥšowaṯṯe ḥa yo. Aʕabdaṯ məlṯo w štayan lebe d yaqre b došno... I naqqayo mʔaṯarle lu xabro, lu xabro mʔaṯarle.
added_examples.translation: That is, great and lowly and so-and-so, with God all of them, their reckoning is one. The word worked, and his heart was appeased, so that he would honour him with a gift... At that moment the line affected him, the line affected him.
added_examples.rationale: First Detransitive evidence for the provisional new entry; heart subject and explanatory context retained. English is the supplied project machine translation, not an edition translation; analysis rests on Turoyo.

added_examples.turoyo: Li məlṯaṯe mʔṯarla aʕle, tamo komər: "Mšayanle lebe..." Yaʕni rakəx lebe, mʔamən lebe du ʕmiro, basəm lebe du ʕmiro.
added_examples.translation: His word affected him. There he says: “His heart was soothed...” That is, his heart softened, the emir's heart became reassured, the emir's heart became pleased.
added_examples.rationale: First likely active evidence; full native paraphrase is essential to interpretation and is retained. English is the supplied project machine translation, not an edition translation; analysis rests on Turoyo.
